app.name: Dawwen
app.tagline: AI Assistant for Code-Switched Arabic & English Meetings
app.description: Record or upload meeting audio. Dawwen delivers accurate minutes, decisions, and tasks with precise source citations.
app.humanInTheLoopNotice: You are always in control — no calendar invite or message is ever sent without your explicit approval.
